class Invoice:

effects.content:
from datetime import date

from src.billing.invoice import Invoice


def test_due_date_adds_terms() -> None:
    invoice = Invoice(date(2026, 10, 1), 30)
    assert invoice.due_date == date(2026, 10, 31)


def test_zero_terms_is_same_day() -> None:
    assert Invoice(date(2026, 10, 1), 0).due_date == date(2026, 10, 1)

envelope.summary: Add due_date to Invoice and cover it with two unit tests
envelope.notes_for_next_agent: due_date is a computed property; no migration was needed.
